title: Board Play Lod Measures Wiring
description: Wire Rust BoardHost automatic_lod + forced_draw_lod, WASM setAutomaticLod/setForcedDrawLodLabel, BoardRenderer/BoardCanvas props, and board play floating window measures (Automatic LOD toggle + LOD tier select when off) so LOD controls are visible in board play.
summary: Fixed persistent empty board when disabling Automatic LOD. Prior fix (stable windowKindRegistryKey) was insufficient: toggling automatic LOD rebuilds boardWindowKinds → boardPlayApp → new inline onActiveWindowChange reference, which was still in UICanvas Golden Layout init effect deps and destroyed all board canvases (WASM hosts lost synced scene; grid-only). Fix: store onLayoutChange/onActiveWindowChange in refs inside UICanvas and remove them from init deps; stabilize board play handler with useCallback; force descriptor re-push on setAutomaticLod; expose data-board-scene-node-count for e2e. E2e now asserts node count > 0 after toggle.
